notes.title: Update content on December 30th
notes.notes:
The game will be updated on December 30th. The update content is as follows:

I. Overall Adjustments
Add multiple new sets of fashion.
Fix the risk of server crashes.
Optimize the frame rate.

II. Out - of - game Adjustments
Open the STEAM trading market function (Steam Inventory), supporting the trading of weapons and armors.
Support multi - selection operation for selling and disassembling items.
Support manual input of quantity when buying and selling items.
In the Arsenal interface, support quick purchase of contracts.
Fix the BUG that selling weapons and armors in practice mode fails to obtain silver coins.

III. In - game Adjustments
Optimize the player's one - click pick - up package function: When picking up, equipment will be automatically worn into the equipment slot.
Team voice can be turned on and off in the audio settings.
Add a batch of new skill items (Power of Chaos).
There are more high - level treasure chests in the underground palace.
Display a kill prompt when killing enemy players.
Optimize PVP combat values.
Optimize and supplement some sound effects.
Fix the BUG that some bosses (Cursed Ox, Black Reef, Heart of Reincarnation) do not drop rewards.
Fix the BUG regarding the problem of randomness in contested areas.
Fix the BUG where the weapon triggers rapid consecutive jump slashes.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The game will be updated on December 21st  10:00 （PST） with the following content:

I. Overall adjustment
1、UI tips adjusted to be more obvious

II. Outside adjustments
1、Fix the potential cause server crash BUG
2、Fix the abnormal BUG of teaming in friends list.

Internal adjustments
1. Increase the number and quality of equipment drops in the newbie area.
2、Fix the bug of afterglow of chaos.
3、Multiplayer fighting, monster damage mechanism adjustment.
4. Adjustment of invitation teaming action in the game
5、Players will have a period of invincibility protection after resurrection or teleportation at the monument.
6、Part of the efficiency optimization (improve frame rate)
7、Optimize some sound effects
8、Fix the bug of randomly selecting the contested area

notes.title: Lost Islands Release Date Trailer | December 18, 2024
notes.notes:
Fellow Islanders:

A new trailer for The Lost Island is now available on the official Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_QpZ906fnwE

For those who are learning about the game for the first time, the general introduction is as follows:
1. the game is a networked game, with a separate standalone contact mode that is not interoperable. 
2. the main gameplay is a “search, fight, retreat” Tarkov-like mode. 
3. teams of up to three players are possible;
4. There will be paid DLC for fashion and some items;

The game is scheduled to be released on Steam on December 18, 2024, and is free to play.

Finally, thank you for the attention and encouragement of every player in the past 6 years, we will see you in the game!
